Stairs, Hallways and Landings

We fit matching floors through hallways and across landings, with matching staircases and stair nosings, for homes across Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire.

Call 07748 146181 WhatsApp Us

Matching Floors Through the Home

Matching hallway and landing installations, and matching staircases and stair nosings, are both on our list of services. Herringbone in particular is popular in hallways and entrance areas, creating an attractive first impression.

We take pride in the small details that make a big difference, from perfectly aligned herringbone patterns to beautifully finished borders, thresholds and staircases.

The Details in a Hallway

Hallways are where the cutting shows: doorways, thresholds, the foot of the stairs and the run past every room. Our fitters take care over every detail, including precise cutting, expansion allowances, doorways, thresholds, skirting and finishing trims.

On herringbone, every installation is carefully set out to ensure accurate alignment, consistent pattern spacing and perfectly balanced borders, so the pattern runs true from the front door to the far end.

Hallways We Have Fitted

The hallways on this page include herringbone run from the front door past a radiator, a long narrow hallway in herringbone, herringbone carried through a doorway into the hall beside the stairs, and plank floors along a hallway past a glass door and along a hall at the top of the stairs. The stairs in these photos are carpeted, so none of them shows a matched staircase.
